exposure: Fasting blood glucose (FBG) thresholds for diagnosis of diabetes in pregnancy (DIP)
outcome: Proportion of missed diagnoses due to altered FBG thresholds
cohort: Antenatal women registered for delivery at a tertiary care center in Pakistan between January 01 and August 31, 2017.
finding: Diabetes in pregnancy (DIP) was diagnosed in 21.8% of women, with a high proportion of overt diabetes mellitus (16.8% of DIP cases), and early detection was often missed in late-registering women.
cross-section timing: Data was collected from charts of women registered for delivery between January 01 and August 31, 2017.
gest_age: Gestational age was extracted from records, but specific ranges for inclusion or primary findings related to it are not mentioned.
